paragraphs: Rabbi Yonah was so called, as in Taanit 23b, and R' Shimon ben Lakish, as in Megillah 28b.[^1]

notes.text: The actual Davidson Taanit 23b paragraph gives Rabbi Yonah as an example of the forceful ones. On Megillah 28b the contrast phrase follows the separate Resh Lakish and Rav Nachman eulogy episodes; it does not itself fully write Shimon ben Lakish. That source pointer remains R' in the new body. Hyman’s grouping is retained without a new collective identity binding or imported eulogy details.
